title: Infinite Loops
concept: while true creates a loop that runs forever — useful for servers, games, and programs that need to run continuously.
why: Some programs are meant to run indefinitely — game loops, server listeners, and interactive prompts. while true is the tool.
tips: `while true` is the idiomatic way to write 'loop forever' in XIOM
Always have an exit strategy — break, return, or external signal
Use infinite loops for programs that should run until explicitly stopped
Test infinite loops with a small iteration limit first before letting them run free
common_mistakes: Creating a truly infinite loop with no exit — program will hang
Putting the exit condition where it can never be reached
Using `while true` when a regular `while condition` would be clearer
